records.alt: Imagined scene: Wind-driven waves roll across a blue-green lake as heavy storm clouds gather above distant hills.
Imagined scene: Simple bread, a red wool cloak and a clay water jug rest beside a sunlit doorway.
Imagined scene: A wooden steering rudder guides a weathered ship through blue water, with distant hills beyond the shore.
Imagined scene: Thin morning mist begins to disappear above a green valley as sunlight reaches the terraced hills.
Imagined scene: Young grain grows in rain-soaked soil beneath a clearing sky, with distant olive trees beyond the field.
